name: cirqo
description: CIRQO Shopping Connector. Answers shopping questions from a brand's verified product data instead of guessing. Every fact in the answer is checked by plain code before it is returned, and ranking is neutral: no brand can pay for placement. Sample data (fictional brands).

tools.name: query
tools.description: Ask a shopping question. Returns one recommended product, alternatives, an answer text built only from verified facts, and the checked claims behind it.

question.description: The shopper's question, e.g. "What is the best laptop under $500 for school?"

constraints.description: Optional. Every field is optional. Without it, maxPrice is taken from a dollar amount in the question.

mustHave.description: battery = 10h+, light = under 3 lb, screen = 15 in+, touch = touchscreen.
